chunks: “We do not cut him off, for he has a share in it.”
And what he narrated does not contradict these two reports:
Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Asamm, from Mismāʿ ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام:
“That Ali عليه السلام was brought a man who had stolen from Bayt al-Mal, so he said:”

key_terms.بَيْتِ الْمَالِ: the public treasury of the Muslim community
key_terms.لَا نَقْطَعُهُ: we do not inflict the penalty of amputation on him
key_terms.نَصِيبًا: a share or allotted portion in the property

ai.seo_question: Why is the hadd of theft not applied to someone who steals from Bayt al-Mal?
ai.summary: This report concerns a legal ruling regarding theft from the public treasury. It indicates that the punishment of cutting is not applied in this case, because the person has a share in Bayt al-Mal, and the narration is introduced with its chain from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام about a judgment of Imam Ali عليه السلام.
